sources.title: Qwen3.6 Flash — AI Model | MindStudio
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6 Flash is a multimodal text generation model developed by Qwen, a research team under Alibaba. Released in April 2026, it supports both text and image inputs and offers a context window of up to one million tokens, allowing it to process very long documents, codebases, or multi-turn conversations within a single session.

sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6 Flash is the speed-optimized model in the Qwen 3.6 family. Released on April 27, 2026, it delivers fast inference with a 1M token context window, full multimodal support (text, image, and video input), and aggressive pricing at $0.25 per 1M input tokens and $1.50 per 1M output tokens.
